en.name: Argentina–China Mining & Resources Forum
en.description: Lithium, copper, and rare-earth producers with Chinese industrial buyers and sovereign wealth-backed investors.
en.metaTitle: Argentina–China Mining & Resources Forum | LATAM China Tech
en.metaDescription: Lithium, copper, and rare-earth producers with Chinese industrial buyers and sovereign wealth-backed investors. Buenos Aires, 15–17 January 2026.
en.overviewHtml: Three days connecting Argentina's mining and resources sector with Chinese industrial buyers, EPC contractors, and sovereign wealth-backed investors.
en.whoShouldAttendHtml: Lithium, copper, and rare-earth producers; equipment suppliers; project finance teams; and Chinese industrial procurement leads.
en.formatHtml: Bilateral matchmaking sessions, a project showcase, and closed-door investor roundtables.

br.name: Forum Argentina–China de Mineracao e Recursos
br.description: Produtores de litio, cobre e terras raras com compradores industriais chineses e investidores apoiados por fundos soberanos.
br.metaTitle: Forum Argentina–China de Mineracao e Recursos | LATAM China Tech
br.metaDescription: Produtores de litio, cobre e terras raras com compradores industriais chineses e investidores apoiados por fundos soberanos. Em Buenos Aires, 15–17 de janeiro de 2026.
br.overviewHtml: Tres dias conectando o setor de mineracao e recursos da Argentina a compradores industriais chineses, empreiteiras EPC e investidores apoiados por fundos soberanos.
br.whoShouldAttendHtml: Produtores de litio, cobre e terras raras; fornecedores de equipamentos; equipes de project finance; e lideres de compras industriais da China.
br.formatHtml: Sessoes bilaterais de matchmaking, uma vitrine de projetos e mesas-redondas fechadas com investidores.

cn.name: 阿根廷–中国矿业与资源论坛
cn.description: 锂、铜和稀土生产商与中国工业买家及主权财富基金支持的投资者对接。
cn.metaTitle: 阿根廷–中国矿业与资源论坛 | LATAM China Tech
cn.metaDescription: 2026年1月15–17日，布宜诺斯艾利斯，锂、铜和稀土生产商与中国工业买家及主权财富基金支持的投资者对接。
cn.overviewHtml: 为期三天，连接阿根廷矿业与资源产业与中国工业买家、EPC 承包商以及主权财富基金支持的投资者。
cn.whoShouldAttendHtml: 锂、铜及稀土生产商；设备供应商；项目融资团队；以及中国工业采购负责人。
cn.formatHtml: 双边对接会、项目展示以及闭门投资者圆桌会议。
